name: audio
description: Procedural SNES-style audio: music, SFX, ambience, and the procedural material/action layer (cooking, footsteps, doors, locks, bodily, combat). Entirely separate from the text-based Sound system. Combat is voiced off two axes that are already authored on every weapon and enemy — weapon_skill outgoing, damage_type incoming — so a new weapon is audible the day it is tagged; the incoming half rides registerDamageObserver, which is sync and query-free by contract.
